nodes.label: Unreplaced Expo Scaffold Assets
nodes.rationale: icon.png, adaptive-icon.png, splash.png and favicon.png are all still the stock Expo template graphics (grey concentric circles on a graph-paper grid, and the generic Expo cube favicon) rather than ReadPanda artwork. The project has since moved to a bare React Native setup with no app.json/app.config, so nothing in the JS tree references them; platform icons and launch screens are configured natively in the iOS project instead. They are dead scaffold files kept only because nobody pruned the original Expo template.
